summary: Drove Playwright Chromium against the LIVE production URL https://mascidocs.com (NOT preview). Production /sign-in renders cleanly with NO preview banner (PASS). However, the primary super-admin operator workflow FAILS on production: after submitting valid super-admin credentials (jaymn.judd@mascigc.com / Maddix123!) on the master /sign-in page, the SPA redirects to '/' (home) instead of '/admin' AdminHubV2. Subsequent navigation to /admin/people and /admin/audit each bounce to /admin/login showing 'SIGN-IN REQUIRED — This workflow requires Admin Portal access'. This means the session/cookie from the multi-login response is NOT being recognized by the production admin guard, even though the platform's own /api/auth/multi-login probe is reported to succeed and return is_super_admin=true. This is a P0 production operator-workflow defect. Because steps 5–11 of Workflow #1 (AdminHubV2 render, /admin/people user-directory count of 43, /admin/audit timeline w/ multi_login event, logout via data-testid='admin-sign-out', re-login, persistence of prior logout event) all REQUIRE successful /admin landing, every one of those steps is now UNABLE-TO-VERIFY on production. Honest report: PASS where evidence supports PASS, FAIL where workflow is broken, UNABLE-TO-VERIFY where the upstream FAIL blocks the check.

PASS: https://mascidocs.com/sign-in renders successfully (HTTP 200, title='MASCI Operations Platform')
Preview banner is ABSENT on /sign-in (no 'PREVIEW ENVIRONMENT' / 'MASCI_SAFETY_PREVIEW' text in DOM) — production env badge check satisfied
Preview banner ABSENT on /, /admin/login as well
Master /sign-in form fully visible: WORK EMAIL + MASTER PASSWORD + SIGN IN button + single-portal links (PM, Shop, HR, Safety, Dispatch, Field Leadership, Admin Console)
Zero HTTP 5xx responses observed during the entire session (network panel clean)
Zero React hydration warnings in browser console
Zero unexpected console errors across /sign-in, /, /admin/login pages

FAIL.title: Super-admin master sign-in does NOT land on /admin AdminHubV2 on production
FAIL.evidence: After filling email=jaymn.judd@mascigc.com + password=Maddix123! on https://mascidocs.com/sign-in and clicking SIGN IN, the SPA navigates to https://mascidocs.com/ (the public Operations Platform marketing/landing page) — NOT https://mascidocs.com/admin. The 'SIGN IN' control in the top-right of '/' is still visible after the redirect (i.e. an unauthenticated-looking header), indicating no admin session was established in the SPA state.
FAIL.reproduction: 1) goto https://mascidocs.com/sign-in 2) fill credentials 3) click SIGN IN 4) observe URL becomes / (not /admin)
FAIL.impact: Operator cannot reach AdminHubV2 → cannot reach /admin/people → cannot reach /admin/audit → cannot exercise the production audit-trail persistence proof required by Track 15.91.

FAIL.title: /admin/people and /admin/audit both redirect to /admin/login (SIGN-IN REQUIRED) after a successful master sign-in attempt
FAIL.evidence: Navigating directly to https://mascidocs.com/admin/people lands on https://mascidocs.com/admin/login with body text 'SIGN-IN REQUIRED — This workflow requires Admin Portal access. After sign-in, you'll continue to Admin Console.' Same behavior for https://mascidocs.com/admin/audit.
FAIL.impact: Production admin guard does not recognize the cookie/token issued by the master /sign-in flow for super_admin. The /api/auth/multi-login probe may succeed at the API level, but the SPA admin guard rejects the resulting session on production.

/admin/people Access Control Center rendering against production DB with 43 users (blocked by PROD-P0-002)

Logout via data-testid='admin-sign-out' (never reached admin chrome — selector not present on /, /sign-in, or /admin/login)
Re-login persistence: audit-log durability proof that the prior logout event survives re-auth (blocked — never logged out from /admin)

Dispatch workflow #2 (dispatch@mascigc.com / DispatchTest2026! on /dispatch-portal/login) — NOT attempted in this run due to the P0 admin defect taking priority; recommend a focused dispatch-only re-test after admin guard is fixed

Public read-only surface render check across /cheatsheet, /jha, /trench-boxes, /inspect/new, /meetings/new, /incidents/new, /daily/new, /equipment/new — NOT executed in this run

rca_hypothesis: Production multi-login likely returns the bundle of 8 portal tokens (as reported by the curl probe) but either (a) the SPA does not persist/forward the admin portal token into the cookie/storage namespace that AdminAuthGuard reads on production, or (b) the cookie is being set with attributes (Domain, SameSite, Secure, HttpOnly, Path) that prevent it from being sent on the /admin/* navigation, or (c) the admin guard on production reads a different storage key than the master sign-in writes. Because the curl-level /api/auth/multi-login probe succeeds and returns is_super_admin=true, this is almost certainly a CLIENT-SIDE session-handoff defect on the deployed bundle (or a cookie attribute mismatch between production domain and SPA expectations) — not a server-side auth defect. Suggested next debug step: capture the Set-Cookie response headers on POST /api/auth/multi-login on production and confirm cookie names + attributes match what AdminAuthGuard checks; compare against preview where the same workflow PASSed at Track 15.90.

final_decision: NO-GO on Track 15.91 LIVE PRODUCTION certification. Two independent blocking findings: (1) the platform's own /api/admin/deployment-readiness already reports decision=fail with 1 blocking_gate (3 unconfigured email routes — operator-data config), AND (2) this Playwright verification has now exposed a P0 client-side admin session-handoff defect on the deployed bundle that prevents super-admin operators from reaching AdminHubV2 on production via the master /sign-in page. Either finding alone is sufficient for NO-GO; both together make NO-GO unambiguous.
